name: VEXAS Syndrome with UBA1 Mutation
aliases: Vacuoles, E1 enzyme, X-linked, Autoinflammatory, Somatic syndrome

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Proposed Diagnostic Criteria for VEXAS Syndrome

criteria.description: Presence of somatic mutation in UBA1 gene
Cytoplasmic vacuoles in myeloid and erythroid precursor cells on bone marrow biopsy
Chronic systemic inflammation with elevated inflammatory markers (e.g., CRP, ESR)
Presence of autoinflammatory clinical features such as fevers, chondritis, skin lesions, or pulmonary infiltrates

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of somatic UBA1 mutation plus cytoplasmic vacuoles in myeloid precursors and systemic inflammation
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires genetic confirmation; clinical features support diagnosis.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Cytoplasmic vacuoles in myeloid and erythroid precursors

pathognomonic.notes: Elevated CRP and ESR despite treatment

common.notes: Inflammation of cartilage causing pain and deformity

common.symptomName: Pulmonary infiltrates and interstitial lung disease

laboratory: Bone marrow biopsy showing cytoplasmic vacuoles in myeloid precursors
imaging: Chest CT showing pulmonary infiltrates or interstitial lung disease
MRI or echocardiogram for cardiac involvement
genetic: Somatic mutations in UBA1 gene detected by sequencing

distinguishingFeatures: Lack of characteristic bone marrow vacuoles
Presence of cytopenias and dysplasia without systemic autoinflammation
No UBA1 mutation or bone marrow vacuoles

redFlags: Refractory systemic inflammation despite immunosuppressive therapy
Progressive cytopenias with bone marrow vacuoles
references: Beck DB, Ferrada MA, Sikora KA, et al. Somatic Mutations in UBA1 and Severe Adult-Onset Autoinflammatory Disease. N Engl J Med. 2020;383(27):2628-2638.
